render.prompt:
Image 1 is a real phone photo of a room to edit. Image 2 is a placement guide: the same photo with numbered translucent boxes showing where each product goes; use it only for position and scale and never draw its boxes or numbers. Images 3 to 7 are the reference photos of products 1 to 5, in order.
1. Add product 1: Beige Linen Loveseat Sofa (sofa), real size 170.2 x 96.5 x 88.9 cm (width x depth x height). Centered against left wall with back to wall and facing into room. It belongs inside box 1 of the placement guide. Copy product 1 exactly from its reference photo: Compact boxy two-seat loveseat in light beige linen with square arms, two loose back and seat cushions, and short tapered dark wood legs. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
2. Add product 2: Cream Chevron Patterned Area Rug (rug), real size 228.6 x 152.4 x 1.3 cm (width x depth x height). Laid on floor center in front of sofa with long edge parallel to sofa. It belongs inside box 2 of the placement guide. Copy product 2 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular cream polyester area rug with subtle tonal chevron pattern and thin border trim. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
3. Add product 3: Glass Column Floor Lamp (floor lamp), real size 33 x 33 x 149.9 cm (width x depth x height). Stands on floor in rear corner by sofa end near window wall. It belongs inside box 3 of the placement guide. Copy product 3 exactly from its reference photo: Tall slender floor lamp with white drum linen shade, clear glass column on brushed nickel square base and metal stem. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
4. Add product 4: Round Traditional Coffee Table (coffee table), real size 96.5 x 96.5 x 48.3 cm (width x depth x height). Placed on rug in front of sofa center, leaving walkway clear. It belongs inside box 4 of the placement guide. Copy product 4 exactly from its reference photo: Round honey pine coffee table with thick wood top, four curved cabriole legs, and lower round shelf. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
5. Add product 5: White Cylindrical Planter with Stand (planter), real size 43.9 x 43.9 x 49.2 cm (width x depth x height). Stands on floor at right end of window wall, clear of outlet and walkway. It belongs inside box 5 of the placement guide. Copy product 5 exactly from its reference photo: Tall cylindrical off-white ceramic planter pot supported by a four-legged dark walnut wood stand with vertical dowels. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
Remove: cardboard moving box front; cardboard moving box back; rolled-up mat. Show the floor and wall that were behind them, continuing the surrounding texture, so it looks like they were never there.
Hard rules: keep the exact same camera position, framing, lens distortion and perspective. Keep the walls, wallpaper, floor, ceiling, ceiling light, windows, blinds or curtains, doors and every object that is not listed exactly as they are. Keep the existing light direction, color temperature and exposure; new products receive the same light and cast soft, physically plausible contact shadows. The result must look like an unedited phone photo of the same room, not a render. Do not add anything else: no extra decor, no text, no numbers, no colored boxes or outlines.
